<p>In this article, I want to share some thoughts on the difference between research ideas and technology, particularly in machine learning. This distinction is have been contemplating since starting my PhD. After joining Google DeepMind and being involved in product releases such as <a href="https://www.deepmind.com/blog/identifying-ai-generated-images-with-synthid" rel="noopener">SynthID</a>, I realized that it can be useful to distinguish between research ideas and technology in many projects, both in industry and academia.</p>
<p>The post <a href="https://davidstutz.de/thinking-about-research-ideas-vs-technology/">Thinking About Research Ideas vs. Technology</a> appeared first on <a href="https://davidstutz.de">David Stutz</a>.</p>
